_comment: Copy to roster.json and fill in. roster.json is gitignored on purpose: it holds names, work emails and Slack member IDs, and this skill lives in a repo that other people can read. Keep the real file out of git and out of chat logs.

_fields.asana_gid: Asana user GID. Find it with the Asana MCP get_users tool, or in the URL of the person's Asana profile.
_fields.name: First name is enough. Used in the DM copy.
_fields.email: Work email for the nudge mail.
_fields.slack_member_id: Slack profile, three-dot menu, Copy member ID. Starts with U.
_fields.timezone: IANA name. This is what stops a Manila nudge firing at 22:30.
_fields.daily_target_hours: Contracted hours per workday. Without this there is no coverage score.
_fields.squad_lead_slack_id: Who gets copied at the top of the escalation ladder. Optional.
_fields.active: Set false to keep someone in the file but out of every calculation, for parental leave or a notice period.
